name: Search settings
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Search settings.
Choose result types and the main form style. Full results support products, pages, and articles; collections are predictive suggestions.
Enable predictive search, set its minimum characters, delay, and per-type limits, then style the result panel. Use actual catalog terms to review loading, no-results, and keyboard behavior.
The popup has its own heading, placeholder, size, and form style. Product filters require Shopify filter configuration.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Predictive min characters
settings.how: Set how many characters a shopper must type before suggestions are requested. This does not prevent submitting a shorter search with the Search button.

settings.label: Predictive debounce (ms)
settings.how: Set how long the search waits after the last keystroke before requesting suggestions, in milliseconds. For example, 250 means a quarter of a second. A longer delay reduces requests but makes suggestions feel slower.
